questions.q: How often were the ancient games held?
questions.model: Read the slide: held every four years. So after 776 BC the next games were in 772 BC.

questions.a: For example: stadion sprint and wrestling

questions.q: Name one piece of evidence about the games.
questions.a: Ruins at Olympia, painted pots or old writings

questions.q: Core: Write a fact file about the ancient Olympics: where, when, events, prize. Use the portal response box or your book.
questions.a: Olympia in Greece; from 776 BC, every four years; stadion, wrestling, chariot racing; olive wreath
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: 'Where: Olympia, Greece. When: from 776 BC, every four years.'

questions.q: Extend: Give one way they were different from today's Olympics.
questions.a: For example: only Greek men could compete; the prize was a wreath, not a medal

questions.q: Stretch: If the games were every four years from 776 BC, when were the next two games?
